```yaml
name: Manual Plugin Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      versionIncrement:
        description: 'Version increment type'
        required: true
        default: 'patch'
        type: choice
        options:
          - major
          - minor
          - patch

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check for concurrent releases
        id: check_concurrent
        run: |
          # Get the current branch name
          BRANCH_NAME=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
          # Check if there are any running release workflows on this branch
          RUNNING_WORKFLOWS=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs \
            --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.status=="running" and .name=="Manual Plugin Release" and .head_branch=="'$BRANCH_NAME'") | .id' \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            --silent)
          
          if [ ! -z "$RUNNING_WORKFLOWS" ]; then
            echo "Concurrent release workflow detected. Exiting."
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "18.x"

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Bump version
        run: |
          # Get current version
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./packages/plugin/manifest.json').version")
          echo "Current version: $CURRENT_VERSION"
          
          # Increment version based on input
          INCREMENT_TYPE="${{ github.event.inputs.versionIncrement }}"
          if [ "$INCREMENT_TYPE" = "major" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "const v = '$CURRENT_VERSION'.split('.'); v[0] = parseInt(v[0]) + 1; v[1] = 0; v[2] = 0; v.join('.')")
          elif [ "$INCREMENT_TYPE" = "minor" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "const v = '$CURRENT_VERSION'.split('.'); v[1] = parseInt(v[1]) + 1; v[2] = 0; v.join('.')")
          else
            NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "const v = '$CURRENT_VERSION'.split('.'); v[2] = parseInt(v[2]) + 1; v.join('.')")
          fi
          
          echo "New version: $NEW_VERSION"
          
          # Update manifest.json
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./packages/plugin/manifest.json', 'utf8'));
            manifest.version = '$NEW_VERSION';
            fs.writeFileSync('./packages/plugin/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
          "
          
          # Update package.json
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./packages/plugin/package.json', 'utf8'));
            pkg.version = '$NEW_VERSION';
            fs.writeFileSync('./packages/plugin/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));
          "
          
          echo "version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        id: version

      - name: Build plugin
        run: pnpm --filter "./packages/plugin" build

      - name: Commit version bump
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add packages/plugin/manifest.json packages/plugin/package.json
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Create tag
        run: |
          git tag -a "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" -m "Release version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Push changes and tags
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF} --follow-tags

      - name: Create Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Create a temporary directory for release files
          mkdir release
          cp packages/plugin/dist/main.js release/
          cp packages/plugin/dist/styles.css release/
          cp packages/plugin/manifest.json release/
          
          # Create release notes from git log
          git log --pretty=format:"- %s" $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD^)..HEAD > release/notes.md
          
          # Create the release
          gh release create "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
            --title="Version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
            --notes-file=release/notes.md \
            --draft=false \
            release/main.js \
            release/styles.css \
            release/manifest.json
```
